### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe clearly. (e.g., "When testing Byzantine fault scenarios, I noticed...")

### Target Package & Files
Which package should this feature live in?
- [ ] `@sx4im/chronos-core` (Zero dependencies, deterministic primitives)
- [ ] `@sx4im/chronos-net` (Virtual network, latency/drops, chaos engine)
- [ ] `@sx4im/chronos-vitest` (Vitest matchers, simTest, failure shrinker)
- [ ] `@sx4im/chronos-cli` (CLI commands: replay, trace, sweep, explain, open)
- [ ] `@sx4im/chronos-inspector` (React time-travel visualizer)
- [ ] `examples/` (Reference distributed system recipes)
